// Postgres access for the operations designed on this service. Generated by Tessery.
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import pg from 'pg'
import { config } from './config.js'

export const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: config.dependencies['__DB_ENV__'], max: Number(process.env.DB_POOL_SIZE ?? 10) })

const LOCK = 727274

const MIGRATIONS = new URL('../migrations/__MIGRATIONS_DIR__/', import.meta.url)

/** Applies each migration that has not run yet, in order and in its own transaction. Replicas wait on a lock. */
export async function migrate(): Promise<void> {
  const files = readdirSync(MIGRATIONS).filter((f) => f.endsWith('.sql')).sort()
  for (let attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      const client = await pool.connect()
      try {
        await client.query('SELECT pg_advisory_lock($1)', [LOCK])
        await client.query('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS _tessery_migrations (name text PRIMARY KEY, applied_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())')
        const done = new Set((await client.query('SELECT name FROM _tessery_migrations')).rows.map((r) => r.name as string))
        for (const file of files) {
          if (done.has(file)) continue
          await client.query('BEGIN')
          try {
            await client.query(readFileSync(new URL(file, MIGRATIONS), 'utf8'))
            await client.query('INSERT INTO _tessery_migrations (name) VALUES ($1)', [file])
            await client.query('COMMIT')
          } catch (e) {
            await client.query('ROLLBACK')
            throw new Error(`migration ${file} failed: ${(e as Error).message}`)
          }
          console.log(`applied migration ${file}`)
        }
      } finally {
        await client.query('SELECT pg_advisory_unlock($1)', [LOCK]).catch(() => undefined)
        client.release()
      }
      return
    } catch (e) {
      if (attempt >= 30 || (e as Error).message.startsWith('migration ')) throw e
      console.error(`database not ready (${(e as Error).message}), retrying in 2s`)
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2000))
    }
  }
}

export interface Result { status: number; body?: unknown }
type Row = Record<string, unknown>

const snake = (k: string) => k.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1_$2').toLowerCase()
const quote = (c: string) => `"${c.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`

/** Turns constraint and input errors into client errors; anything else is a bug and propagates. */
function rejected(e: unknown): Result {
  const { code, column, constraint } = e as { code?: string; column?: string; constraint?: string }
  const detail = (e as Error).message
  if (code === '23502' && column) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'invalid', field: column, detail: `${column} is required` } }
  if (code === '23505') return { status: 409, body: { error: 'already_exists', detail: constraint ? `a row with this value already exists (${constraint})` : detail } }
  if (code === '23503') return { status: 409, body: { error: 'reference_not_found', detail } }
  if (code && ['23502', '23514', '22P02', '22007', '22003', '22001', '42703'].includes(code)) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'invalid', detail } }
  throw e
}

/** Query keys a list understands besides column names. */
const RESERVED = new Set(['limit', 'offset', 'page', 'q', 'sort'])
const textType = (t: string) => t === 'text' || t === 'citext' || t.startsWith('varchar') || t.startsWith('character')
const like = (s: string) => `%${s.replace(/[\\%_]/g, (c) => `\\${c}`)}%`
const first = (v: unknown) => (Array.isArray(v) ? v[0] : v)

export function table(name: string, key: string, types: Record<string, string>, writable: string[], order: string) {
  const has = (c: string) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(types, c)
  const pick = (body: unknown): Row => {
    const out: Row = {}
    if (body && typeof body === 'object' && !Array.isArray(body)) {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(body as Row)) {
        const c = snake(k)
        if (writable.includes(c)) out[c] = v
      }
    }
    return out
  }
  const where = (filter: Row, from: number) => {
    const keys = Object.keys(filter)
    return { sql: keys.map((k, i) => `${quote(k)} = $${i + from}::text::${has(k) ? types[k] : 'text'}`).join(' AND '), values: keys.map((k) => String(filter[k])) }
  }

  return {
    /** ?q= searches text columns, ?<column>= filters, ?sort=<column> or -<column> orders, ?page= or ?offset= with ?limit= pages. */
    async list(query: Record<string, unknown>, filter: Row = {}): Promise<Result> {
      const limit = Math.min(Math.max(Number(first(query.limit) ?? 50) || 50, 1), 500)
      const page = Math.max(Number(first(query.page) ?? 1) || 1, 1)
      const offset = query.offset !== undefined ? Math.max(Number(first(query.offset)) || 0, 0) : (page - 1) * limit
      const match: Row = {}
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(query)) if (has(k) && !RESERVED.has(k) && first(v) !== undefined && first(v) !== '') match[k] = first(v)
      const w = where({ ...match, ...filter }, 1)
      const parts = w.sql ? [w.sql] : []
      const values: unknown[] = [...w.values]
      const search = String(first(query.q) ?? '').trim()
      const text = Object.keys(types).filter((c) => textType(types[c])).sort()
      if (search && text.length) {
        values.push(like(search))
        parts.push(`(${text.map((c) => `${quote(c)} ILIKE $${values.length}`).join(' OR ')})`)
      }
      const sort = String(first(query.sort) ?? '')
      const by = has(sort.replace(/^-/, '')) ? `${quote(sort.replace(/^-/, ''))} ${sort.startsWith('-') ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'}, ${order}` : order
      try {
        const r = await pool.query(`SELECT * FROM ${quote(name)}${parts.length ? ` WHERE ${parts.join(' AND ')}` : ''} ORDER BY ${by} LIMIT ${limit} OFFSET ${offset}`, values)
        return { status: 200, body: r.rows }
      } catch (e) {
        return rejected(e)
      }
    },

    async get(id: string, filter: Row = {}): Promise<Result> {
      const w = where({ [key]: id, ...filter }, 1)
      try {
        const r = await pool.query(`SELECT * FROM ${quote(name)} WHERE ${w.sql}`, w.values)
        return r.rows[0] ? { status: 200, body: r.rows[0] } : { status: 404, body: { error: 'not_found' } }
      } catch (e) {
        return rejected(e)
      }
    },

    async create(body: unknown, fixed: Row = {}): Promise<Result> {
      const row = { ...pick(body), ...fixed }
      const cols = Object.keys(row)
      const sql = cols.length
        ? `INSERT INTO ${quote(name)} (${cols.map(quote).join(', ')}) VALUES (${cols.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`).join(', ')}) RETURNING *`
        : `INSERT INTO ${quote(name)} DEFAULT VALUES RETURNING *`
      try {
        const r = await pool.query(sql, cols.map((c) => row[c]))
        return { status: 201, body: r.rows[0] }
      } catch (e) {
        return rejected(e)
      }
    },

    async update(id: string, body: unknown, filter: Row = {}): Promise<Result> {
      const row = pick(body)
      delete row[key]
      const cols = Object.keys(row)
      if (!cols.length) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'invalid', detail: `nothing to update; writable fields are ${writable.join(', ')}` } }
      const w = where({ [key]: id, ...filter }, cols.length + 1)
      try {
        const r = await pool.query(`UPDATE ${quote(name)} SET ${cols.map((c, i) => `${quote(c)} = $${i + 1}`).join(', ')} WHERE ${w.sql} RETURNING *`, [...cols.map((c) => row[c]), ...w.values])
        return r.rows[0] ? { status: 200, body: r.rows[0] } : { status: 404, body: { error: 'not_found' } }
      } catch (e) {
        return rejected(e)
      }
    },

    async remove(id: string, filter: Row = {}): Promise<Result> {
      const w = where({ [key]: id, ...filter }, 1)
      try {
        const r = await pool.query(`DELETE FROM ${quote(name)} WHERE ${w.sql}`, w.values)
        return r.rowCount ? { status: 204 } : { status: 404, body: { error: 'not_found' } }
      } catch (e) {
        return rejected(e)
      }
    },
  }
}
